guard: the session view opens and closes its session in pairs, says every state in the mock's words, shows the plane note only when the card says the plane is on, animates only steps that arrive live after mount, keeps a reader at the message they arrived at, shows Live only for an agent that is online, and goes back where the reader came from
why: This suite runs `tsx` directly over `client/src`, with no build step and no compiled second copy, so no `afterRestore` is needed on any mutation here.

mutations.name: SV1 the view never closes its session on unmount, so the store's count of views leaks
mutations.expectRed: 1.1 mounting calls openSession once and unmounting calls closeSession once
mutations.cell: 1.1 mounting calls openSession once and unmounting calls closeSession once

mutations.name: SV2 the plane note shows whenever the card does not say off, so an agent whose card is silent is said to publish
mutations.expectRed: 3.1 the plane note shows for on and not for unknown
mutations.cell: 3.1 the plane note shows for on and not for unknown

mutations.name: SV3 every step new to the list rises in, history included
mutations.expectRed: 8.1 steps a history read adds after mount carry no ui-in, nor do the steps of the first paint
mutations.cell: 8.1 steps a history read adds after mount carry no ui-in, nor do the steps of the first paint

mutations.name: SV4 Live shows for an offline agent
mutations.find: const live = load === "ok" && plane !== "off" && known !== undefined && known.status !== "offline";
mutations.replace: const live = load === "ok" && plane !== "off" && known !== undefined;
mutations.expectRed: 6.1 Live is absent for an offline agent, and shown for a working one
mutations.cell: 6.1 Live is absent for an offline agent, and shown for a working one

mutations.name: SV5 Load earlier stays at the cap
mutations.expectRed: 4.2 at 2,000 events the cap line replaces Load earlier
mutations.cell: 4.2 at 2,000 events the cap line replaces Load earlier

mutations.name: SV6 a reload that holds frames draws skeleton rows over them
mutations.expectRed: 2.8 a reload that holds frames keeps them on screen with a quiet loading line, not skeleton rows
mutations.cell: 2.8 a reload that holds frames keeps them on screen with a quiet loading line, not skeleton rows

mutations.name: SV7 the broker's reason is set as HTML
mutations.expectRed: 2.2 refused names the session, quotes the broker's reason as text and offers the grant to copy
mutations.cell: 2.2 refused names the session, quotes the broker's reason as text and offers the grant to copy

mutations.name: SV8 the crumb forgets where the reader came from and always goes back to Agents
mutations.expectRed: 9.1 the crumb links back to the channel the reader came from
mutations.cell: 9.1 the crumb links back to the channel the reader came from

mutations.name: SV9 the arrival scroll does not wait for the read in flight
mutations.expectRed: 7.2 arriving while the read is in flight waits for it, scrolls to the post after the pin, and stops following
mutations.cell: 7.2 arriving while the read is in flight waits for it, scrolls to the post after the pin, and stops following

mutations.name: SV10 the arrival leaves the view following, so the next step pulls it to the bottom
mutations.expectRed: 7.2 arriving while the read is in flight waits for it, scrolls to the post after the pin, and stops following
mutations.cell: 7.2 arriving while the read is in flight waits for it, scrolls to the post after the pin, and stops following

mutations.name: SV11 a group that a joining call makes appears at once
mutations.expectRed: 8.3 a call that joins a single one fades the new group in, and a group there at first paint does not fade
mutations.cell: 8.3 a call that joins a single one fades the new group in, and a group there at first paint does not fade

mutations.name: SV12 only a channel is remembered as the place to go back to
mutations.expectRed: 9.4 the crumb goes back to the last place that was not a session, with its label, not to the last channel
mutations.cell: 9.4 the crumb goes back to the last place that was not a session, with its label, not to the last channel
